def factor_gap_intraday_persistence_ewm20(df):
    """Overnight-intraday persistence spread with faster EWM smoothing."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    overnight_trend = overnight_ret.ewm(span=20, adjust=False, min_periods=10).mean()
    intraday_trend = intraday_ret.ewm(span=20, adjust=False, min_periods=10).mean()
    factor = overnight_trend - intraday_trend
    factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    factor.name = "factor_gap_intraday_persistence_ewm20"
    return factor
description: Parent mechanism preserved: overnight gap continuation minus intraday mean reversion, representing persistent accumulation/distribution. Mutation replaces 60-day simple moving averages with 20-day exponentially weighted moving averages to reduce lag and improve raw signal responsiveness for IC/ICIR while retaining the same economic orientation. The prior cs_rank transform is removed to keep raw return magnitudes for better payoff thickness; cross-sectional comparability is still provided by the engine neutralization gate. One core mechanism only, no auxiliary feature.
